messages.author: b2bfa6e6cdc6794b
messages.subject: Distance software compatible with Windows 10?
parts:
Hi

I have a Mac and want to buy parallels to be able to use Distance, R and ArcGis. It is cheaper than buying a new computer that is for sure! So, I was told by microsoft that I need to buy Windows 10...but, is Distance compatible with this latest version? I am wondering if R is as well.

Would anyone know? 

Help! I am a poor graduate student and I can't afford to buy a new computer!

Thanks so much

Aliyah.

messages.author: 8fbbf490c07a1909
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Distance software compatible with Windows 10?
parts:
Hi Aliyah

We run distance softeware in windows on parallels without issues.  For R work I prefer to do it on the mac side R studio. The R objects created in Distance in windows work just fine in R on the mac. You just have to enable a couple of shared folders through the parallels software.

Feel free to shoot me any technical questions about setting up Distance etc. in parallels off list. 

Cheers,

Stewart

messages.author: a5a55c9d2f0bd95b
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Distance software compatible with Windows 10?
parts:
Hi Aliyah

I've been running Distance on my Mac on Bootcamp which you might also consider. This is free, and allows you to use all the memory of your computer, unlike Parallels. The annoying aspect is that you can only switch operating systems by restarting, but I find it manageable.

Happy to help if you choose this and have any set-up questions.

All the best -
Clare
